summary: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K containing Items 2.02 and 8.01 to announce its financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, with total revenue of $1.1 billion, a net loss of $25 million, and Adjusted EBITDA of $205 million. The filing also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.10 per share payable June 15, 2026. No special-situation transaction or corporate event is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings report. Without an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring, this is not a special situation.
